title: Lingering eitr mead

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Lingering eitr mead is an Ashlands-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Lingering eitr.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Mead base: Lingering eitr is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Sap
• 10 Vineberry cluster
• 10 Magecap
Six Lingering eitr meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: Upon consumption, it provides +25% eitr regeneration for 5 minutes. While active, it prevents the consumption of all types of eitr meads.

full_text:
Lingering eitr mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadEitrLingering | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Lingering eitr x1 | Max Eitr: +25% eitr regeneration | Duration: 5m

Introduction. Lingering eitr mead is an Ashlands-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Lingering eitr.

Recipe. Mead base: Lingering eitr is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Sap
• 10 Vineberry cluster
• 10 Magecap
Six Lingering eitr meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

Effect. Upon consumption, it provides +25% eitr regeneration for 5 minutes. While active, it prevents the consumption of all types of eitr meads.
